purpose: Local canonical proof pins and explicitly scoped primary literature imports. Remote sources are cited, not claimed locally hash-pinned or independently replayed.

external_sources.title: Brassil--Reichstein: The Hermite-Joubert problem over p-fields
external_sources.used_for: Necessity of the binary trace-form test when N is invertible; classical odd-degree/Springer transfer.

external_sources.title: Edens--Reichstein: Essential dimension of symmetric groups in prime characteristic
external_sources.used_for: Integral root quadric and modular sufficient binary conditions. N-4 essential dimension is not promoted to an affine Keller-map bound.

external_sources.title: Duncan: Essential Dimensions of A7 and S7
Casselman: Quadratic forms over local fields
external_sources.used_for: Nonarchimedean isotropy in dimension greater than four, including dyadic fields.

external_sources.title: Bayer-Fluckiger--Parimala--Serre: Hasse Principle for G-quadratic forms
external_sources.used_for: Classical local-global quadratic-form theorem over number fields, not a stronger equivariant principle.

external_sources.title: Arpin--Bozlee--Herr--Smith: The scheme of monogenic generators I and II
external_sources.used_for: Generator/configuration spaces and twists; no novelty claim for their representability.

external_sources.title: Chebolu--Minac--Nikzad--Ure: A septic covariant and the Hermite--Joubert problem in degree seven
external_sources.used_for: New AI-assisted alternative first/third trace elimination; direct compiler compatibility limited by residual weights6,8. Announced generalizations are not imported as proved.
